channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: In show of support, France and Canada open consulates in Greenland
item.description: France and Canada, which both oppose US President Donald Trump's claim to Greenland, opened consulates in the Danish autonomous territory's capital on Friday, in a show of support for the local government.

item.title: What do Europeans really think about immigration?
item.description: Growing political polarisation means that debate about immigration is boiled down to 'pro' or 'anti'-immigration positions, but new surveys reveal that European public opinion is a little more nuanced than that.

item.title: Floods and snow, property, and a question: essential articles for life in France
item.description: This week’s practical must-reads from The Local feature advice on what to do if you live in an area under a flood warning, the latest snow news for winter sports lovers, an update on France’s Budget now that we have one, and why the Île de Ré is so expensive.

item.title: French Expression of the Day: Rouler dans la farine
item.description: France loves a good food metaphor, and this is definitely one of the strangest.

item.title: Can you sign over your French property to your children without paying tax?
item.description: Is there a legal way of avoiding inheritance tax in France by passing your property onto your children while you’re still alive?

item.title: French citizenships fall after new rule blocking retirees
item.description: A new rule on French income that effectively excludes foreign retirees from ever becoming French has led to a significant fall in the number of people being naturalised, according to the Interior Ministry.

item.title: On the Agenda: What’s happening in France this week
item.description: A controversial bill to authorise certain insecticides is back in the news, a French astronaut is set to make history, the second wave of school holidays begin, and census takers are set to hit the streets.

item.title: 'Large-scale' avalanche kills two skiers in French Alps
item.description: An avalanche has killed two off-piste ski tourers in the French Alps, a local prosecutor said on Sunday.

item.title: Veteran French politician loses culture post over Epstein links
item.description: Veteran French politician Jack Lang, a former minister, was forced out of a key cultural post Saturday as pressure grew on him over revelations in the latest release of the Epstein files.

item.title: French police arrest five over crypto-linked magistrate kidnapping
item.description: French authorities have arrested five suspects after a magistrate and her mother were held captive last week for around 30 hours in a cryptocurrency ransom plot, prosecutors said on Sunday.
